title: Expand Firecracker execution adapter contract and fail-closed fixture
purpose: Define the Firecracker execution adapter as a SecurityExecution profile with explicit dependency probing, run reports, and fail-closed fixtures.
scope: Define probe results for KVM, firecracker binary, jailer, kernel image, rootfs image, and network mode.
Define microVM execution plan and report contracts.
Define artifact retention and redaction contract.
Define fail-closed behavior before EffectPrepared when dependencies are missing.
implementation_steps: Define Firecracker availability and missing-dependency fixture shapes.
Define microVM execution report fields and required audit metadata.
Define how sandbox profile metadata binds to CapabilityLease.
Record evidence with optional QEMU/Firecracker smoke boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Planner hints cannot broaden sandbox or network policy.
verification: Run `cargo test -p security_execution firecracker` if matching tests exist or are added.
failure_modes: Missing dependency is discovered after host side effect.
VM artifacts are retained without redaction.
Network allowlist can be widened by planner hints.

blocked_until: Firecracker adapter contract and fail-closed fixtures are defined.
